From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@nimbuscloud.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procureops@nimbuscloud.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 16:14:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood marketplace seller onboarding — forms and PO path

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. We're ready to move NimbusCloud onto the Redwood marketplace but the listing team requires a completed vendor packet and a PO path confirmation before we can publish the listing. I've attached the seller intake packet and the legal/vendor form set for your procurement team to review.

Quick summary:
- We require a purchase order (PO) or signed marketplace agreement for EU-region listings.
- Billing contact + remit-to must be confirmed before activation.
- Typical timeline after PO: 3-5 business days for listing review.

Attachments:
- Nimbus_Marketplace_Seller_Forms.pdf (pdf)
- Nimbus_PO_Template.docx (docx)

Can you confirm the billing entity and who at Redwood will raise the PO? Also, does Redwood require any vendor onboarding questionnaire completed by us? Happy to loop in ProcureOps (cc'd) if that helps.

Best,

Megan Liu
Head of Partnerships, NimbusCloud
megan.liu@nimbuscloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace seller onboarding — forms and PO path

Hi Megan — thanks for the packet and the templates. Welcome — we're excited to get Nimbus listed.

Short answers:
- We typically invoice EU marketplace vendors via our Redwood EMEA entity for listings that will be billed to EMEA customers. If the marketplace listing is global but the vendor prefers US billing, we can route to Redwood Inc instead.
- Redwood does require a short vendor questionnaire for security/compliance; that form is usually completed by the vendor (I see ProcureOps cc'd — that should handle it).

Vanessa (cc) — can you confirm whether we need any additional field-level PO info (billing codes or legal clause) for Nimbus before we ask them to sign? Also, Laura — would you prefer we use the attached Nimbus_PO_Template or generate a Redwood PO (I can forward this to procurement once you confirm).

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement confirm remit-to and entity (Vanessa/Laura)
2) Megan/ProcureOps return signed PO or DocuSign link
3) We complete marketplace intake and publish listing (target within 3-5 business days after PO)

Thanks — I'll wait for procurement confirmation and will hold the listing request until we have the PO.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Laura / Vanessa — forwarding Nimbus packet from Megan. They need a PO or signed agreement before listing; they indicated EU listing requires a PO. See attachments (Nimbus_PO_Template.docx).

Questions for procurement (one-liners):
- Which legal entity should we bill for a Nimbus EU listing? Redwood EMEA (preferred) or Redwood Inc? Please reply with the exact remit-to name and address to pass to the vendor.
- Do we need a Redwood-generated PO (we can create a PO in Coupa) or will the vendor accept their PO template with our signature?
- Any specific tax or billing fields we should add (VAT id, billing code, department GL)?

Recommended approach (if quick):
1) Confirm remit-to = "Redwood EMEA Ltd, 10 Southbank Ave, London, UK" (example) if EMEA listing is required.
2) Use vendor's Nimbus_PO_Template and countersign (faster) unless legal needs redlines.
3) If vendor needs full contract, escalate to Legal (Vanessa can advise).

If you can confirm by EOD today I will send the countersigned PO back to Megan and request the DocuSign route for the seller forms.

Thanks — Sergio
Head of Channel Sales
